name: Rheology of Complex Fluids
description: Introductory fluid mechanics and constitutive relation. Non-Newtonian fluids. Rheology of non-Newtonian fluids. Measurements and material functions. Simple and advanced models for polymeric fluids: the generalized newtonian fluids, linear viscoelasticity, nonlinear viscoelasticity. Simple models for suspensions and emulsions. Rheological characterization of complex fluids - analysis of experimental measurements. Classical methods: steady and oscillatory shear flow. Modern methods: transient elongation; interfacial rheology; introduction to optical birefringence.
